lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Local vector layers remain editable and accept standard WGS84 coordinate files
value.statement: A vector layer created in the application or imported from a local GeoJSON file is editable by default. GeoJSON without an explicit CRS is WGS84; CRS84 and common EPSG:4326 URN or OGC URL forms are accepted as WGS84, while EPSG:3857 aliases are converted through the existing Web Mercator path and other coordinate systems remain unsupported. A local KML or GPX file is treated as WGS84 and every valid coordinate, in source order, becomes a separate point in one editable layer; source geometry, styling and route/track topology are deliberately not retained. SQLite bulk-write PRAGMAs are configured before the import transaction and are never changed from inside an active transaction. An editable local layer remains in the object-creation picker while hidden; choosing it enables and saves visibility before editing starts.
